limitations: Static imports and calls through lexically bound imports only.
Literal path.join/resolve calls rooted at unshadowed __dirname produce file-path candidates, not module dependencies or proof of disk access.
typeOnly records explicit syntax; an ordinary import may still be erased as a type by the repository compiler.
Full-file relationships may predate the PR; changed flags indicate overlap with added head-side lines.
Imported member calls identify the imported object, not the resolved method implementation.
No whole-program dispatch, package-alias resolution, or complete runtime call graph.
Removed files use captured base-side source and are not current-head dependencies.
